EXPLANATION: The spectrum is that of a saturated alkyl with strong C–H stretches at 2871/2929/2972 cm⁻¹ (consistent with aliphatic CH; GFQ-003) and typical bending modes near 1446 cm⁻¹ (CH₂ scissoring; GFQ-003). The very strong band at 562 cm⁻¹ is characteristic of an aliphatic C–Br stretch, favoring a bromoalkane; 1,1-dibromoethane (CC(Br)Br) best fits having a prominent C–Br mode without the C–Cl band expected near 700–800 cm⁻¹. Additional skeletal/alkyl modes at 1065 cm⁻¹ (C–C stretch; GFQ-010) and ~961/1243 cm⁻¹ (alkyl rocking/wagging) further support a simple dibromide.
